parameters.name: MODE_APP
parameters.help: Select AGC only, AGC and save scalars, or remove a previously saved AGC operation.

parameters.name: MODE_AMP
parameters.help: AGC scalars can be computed using the MEAN, RMS, or MEDIAN of the samples in the sliding time gate.

parameters.name: AGCLEN
parameters.help: Amplitude estimation operator length in milliseconds for sliding gate AGC.

parameters.name: MODE_WIN
parameters.help: For normal operations CENTERED should be used.  TRAILING and LEADING will distort waveforms.

parameters.name: mode_option
parameters.help: 'Hard zeroes' (0.0 values) may be excluded from scalar computations.  This avoids strange mute effects.

parameters.name: robust_option
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to limit the AGC scaling to be within a factor of the median scalar.

parameters.name: ROBUST
parameters.help: Forces the AGC scale factor to be within this factor of the median scalar.
